paper_title: Getting the most on supernova axions
notes: Lower boundary (strongest/reach edge) of the combined SN1987A excluded region in the g_ap vs m_a plane, Fig.3 (vector extraction from Figure3.pdf; frame calibrated from decade ticks). Paper sets g_an=0 (KSVZ-inspired C_ap=-0.47, C_an=0). Coupling is already in the canonical 2m_N convention: L = g_a (d^mu a/2m_N)[C_ap pbar gamma_mu gamma5 p + ...], g_ap = g_a*C_ap (Eq. in Appendix A), so g_ap = C_p m_N/f_a; no conversion applied. The reported curve is the lower edge of the SN1987A cooling region (blue), which dominates the lower envelope; the SN1987A(events)/KII region (green) sits at higher couplings (g_ap>~2.4e-7) and does not affect the lower reach. Flat cooling bound g_ap~6.2e-10 for m_a up to ~2e7 eV (abstract/Sec.III: 6e-10, upper trapping edge ~2.5e-6), rising and closing near m_a~3e8 eV (~O(100 MeV)); consistent with text 7e-10 lower bound at m~O(100 MeV). SNO(red) region is external (Ref.[3]), not this paper's result. Non-DM astrophysical bound so dm_density and statistical CL are null.
